key_highlights: RBA issues blunt hawkish warning ahead of imminent rate decision; IMF separately urges spending cuts, signalling further hikes likely
ASX closed volatile week with modest gains as oil prices and bond yields eased; big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) led advances
Recession odds for 2027 rising per macrobusiness; 'four horsemen' narrative gaining traction for global economy
Iron ore prices under pressure ('roaches seethe'); LNG exports to Japan surging while East Coast gas supply tightens
Qantas ground staff strike looms over Joyce-era bargaining agreements; Coles retains milk pricing power despite axing farmer support
Anthropic secures $31bn datacentre deal in western Queensland — major infrastructure/tech catalyst
Housing affordability at record lows; tenants see modest relief; petrol price shock adds to cost-of-living pressure
Warren Buffett (96) steps down as Berkshire chairman — global risk-appetite signal
Forrestania and Aurum advance gold prefeasibility studies; ASX small-caps (Latrobe, CurveBeam, Arrow, Sultan) outperform

sectors.trend: Iron ore under pressure with China demand concerns; gold projects (Forrestania, Aurum) advancing prefeasibility; LNG exports to Japan strong but East Coast supply tight
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term headwinds from soft iron ore; gold juniors (AUR.AX, FGN.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows; Woodside (WDS.AX) and Santos (STO.AX) supported by LNG pricing but constrained by domestic supply

sectors.trend: Big four banks advanced on easing yields; RBA hawkish stance supports NIMs but caps credit growth; Qantas strike adds operational risk to transport-linked lending
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher-for-longer rates; insurance (CGU.AX, IAG.AX) watch for strike-related claims; ASX200 Financials index (^AX5J) likely outperforms

sectors.trend: Petrol price shock hits consumers; Victoria retreats from renewable transmission; Middle East oil shock risk elevated; coal policy under political pressure
sectors.implications: Oil majors (WDS.AX, STO.AX) see upside from Middle East risk premium; renewable developers (INW.AX, LEM.AX) face policy headwind in Victoria; AGL.AX, CSG.AX benefit from gas supply tightness

sectors.trend: Coles retains pricing power on milk; EV adoption accelerating; housing unaffordability constrains discretionary spend; Qantas strike disrupts travel
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOL.AX benefit from pricing power but face margin scrutiny; QAN.AX faces strike risk; EV transition pressures oil refiners (VIV.AX); housing (MRG.AX, LVH.AX) under affordability pressure

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre a landmark; AI infrastructure spend global; ASX small-caps (CurveBeam, Latrobe) outperform; Buffett exit signals generational shift
sectors.implications: Datacentre/infrastructure plays (VIX.AX, SRG.AX) benefit; CSL.AX and healthcare tech supported by flu spike demand; global AI capex cycle (CoreWeave, Iren) creates indirect demand for Australian power/infra

sectors.trend: Flu spike strains regional health services; tenants see modest rent relief; superannuation system under structural critique
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SWL.AX, HIC.AX supported by demand; REITs (VAP.AX, DGL.AX) see modest tenant relief but yield compression risk from rate path; super fund flows (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) face policy uncertainty

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot and IMF fiscal warning create a higher-for-longer rate regime
2027 recession probability rising — global 'four horsemen' narrative
Commodity bifurcation: iron ore weak, gold and LNG firm
Cost-of-living squeeze: petrol, housing, milk prices all elevated
Industrial action risk (Qantas) and political instability (NT, immigration debate)
AI/datacentre infrastructure as structural growth theme (Anthropic QLD deal)
Generational leadership transition (Buffett exit) reshaping global capital allocation

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce leverage; favour rate-sensitive bank equities (CBA.AX, NAB.AX) over growth
Diversify away from cyclical materials; increase allocation to defensives (WES.AX, CSL.AX, REITs)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East oil shock / geopolitical escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure via WDS.AX, STO.AX; monitor Brent crude; consider gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) as hedge
Reduce QAN.AX exposure pre-strike; monitor travel-linked REITs (airport, hotel)
Underweight residential REITs (VAP.AX, DGL.AX); monitor NAB.AX, ANZ.AX loan-loss provisions
Reduce BHP.AX, FMG.AX weight; rotate into gold and LNG names

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight big four banks ahead of RBA hike
opportunities.rationale: Higher rates support NIMs; banks led ASX gains this week; CBA and NAB best positioned

opportunities.recommendation: Add gold and LNG exposure as commodity rotation
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore weak but gold (Forrestania, Aurum) and LNG (Japan demand) firm; safe-haven flows into gold
Anthropic $31bn QLD deal signals sustained capex; power and infrastructure demand structural

opportunities.recommendation: Selective consumer staples for pricing power
opportunities.rationale: Coles retains milk pricing; WES/WOL benefit from inflation pass-through despite volume risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce cyclical materials and transport exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore weakness, Qantas strike risk, and recession odds rising create downside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge with short-duration bonds and gold
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hike and IMF fiscal warning support yields; gold hedges geopolitical and recession risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight residential REITs and housing-linked equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Record unaffordability, tenant relief signals, and credit stress risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to mildly negative into RBA decision. Banks and defensives outperform; materials and transport lag. Volatility elevated on oil/geopolitical headlines. Expect 1–2% index swings around rate announcement.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Rising 2027 recession odds, RBA higher-for-longer, and global 'four horsemen' narrative cap upside. Structural themes (AI infrastructure, gold, LNG) provide selective pockets of growth. Consumer squeeze and housing stress weigh on breadth.
key_catalysts: US Fed policy and Buffett/Berkshire succession impact
watch_list: RBA cash rate and statement (next meeting)
LNG spot pricing (Japan vs East Coast)
Gold price (USD/oz) and ASX gold miners
